interboard.connector: FX8C-80P-SV1(92) / FX8C-80S-SV5(92), straight SMT, 80 contacts, 11-mm working gap
interboard.why_not_20_or_60: The current 4.25-A step envelope receives fourteen parallel 3V3_MAIN contacts and fourteen primary return contacts, leaving 0.304 A per power contact versus the 0.4-A rating before H3/H5 thermal proof. After two AON contacts, signal-reference returns and 25 live signals, a 60-contact pair has no controlled reserve; 80 is the smallest current FX8C size that preserves both derating and fourteen NC contacts.
interboard.video: K331 remains rear-local; one 75-ohm FPV_CVBS net crosses M1 beside a dedicated return. TVP5150 and all eight data lines plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF remain UI-local beside S3.

locality_contract.rule: Every payload endpoint stays on the board that owns its controller. M1 carries no display bus, camera parallel bus, nRF/SPI payload, microSD payload, main RF trace or audio stream.

intentional_crossings.hub_rf_ipc: five point-to-point Hub-RF control/data wires are the sole compute-domain message path
intentional_crossings.fpv_cvbs: one rear-receiver analog CVBS feed crosses to the front-local decoder beside its dedicated return
intentional_crossings.s3_usb: the rear/bottom power-and-service receptacle reaches the front S3 native USB pair directly
intentional_crossings.encoder: the externally reachable rear encoder remains direct to S3 PCNT plus one local-expander push input
intentional_crossings.safety_and_evidence: AON safety, thermal and TX-evidence nets cross to the rear safety controller by design

interboard.mechanical_load_path: M1 is electrical/alignment only. Four 11.00-mm compression stops, two anti-shear enclosure datums and independent front/rear PCB capture lips constrain the boards when one screw is loose; no drop, installation or enclosure-bending load is accepted through the SMT joints.
interboard.result: R2 uses 25 live signals, fourteen 3V3_MAIN contacts, twenty-five defined returns, two AON contacts and fourteen true NC reserve contacts; no obsolete audio or M5 signal remains assigned.

display.panel: EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 configured with ER-TPC035-6 capacitive touch; ILI9488 + FT6236
display.interface: dedicated direct i8080-8 (Intel 8080) on S3 LCD_CAM TX with GDMA; D0..D7, WR and DC are direct, CS is hard-low because the bus is exclusive, RD is hard-high, IM[2:0]=011, reset remains on the local slow-I/O output, and front Hub captures TE plus drives reset-off backlight PWM
display.controller_limit_basis: ILI9488 v1.00 section 17.4.1 specifies a 40-ns minimum DBI Type-B write cycle and 15-ns minimum WR high/low widths; 24 MHz gives a 41.667-ns cycle and 20.833-ns nominal half-period.
display.s3_supported_sources: ESP32-S3 LCD_CAM has separate LCD TX and camera RX control units, supports simultaneous external LCD and camera connection, an 8-bit i8080 output and GDMA. The selected 24-MHz write clock is below both the S3 8-bit-i80 capability and the exact ILI9488 timing limit.
display.video_window: 320x240 RGB565 at 30 fps is 4.608 MB/s and 19.2% of the selected i8080 payload
display.gpio_closure: All 33 exposed S3 GPIO are assigned: 11 camera RX, 10 direct i8080 outputs, 5 chip-select-free S3-Hub quad data/clock, 2 UI I2C, 2 USB, 2 encoder and 1 wired-OR UI/Hub alert. TE and backlight PWM consume Hub GPIO45/46 instead of S3 pins.
display.fallback: The exact 50-contact panel also exposes ILI9488 4-wire serial mode. A deliberate adapter strap revision can select it only as first-prototype recovery if simultaneous LCD_CAM TX/RX or the i8080 timing gate fails; it is ordinary serial SPI, not QSPI, and is not the preferred interface.
display.maximality_result: Direct i8080-8 at the exact panel-safe 24 MHz is 1.2x faster than the former 40-MHz four-lane QSPI wire rate without adding a processor, moving buttons off S3 or sharing display traffic with storage/radio IPC.
display.hil: Before fabrication, compile and run the simultaneous LCD_TX/CAM_RX DMA harness on the emulator-supported register model. H5 then proves ILI9488 IM straps, 24-MHz edges, TE timestamp latency, full-frame/dirty-region timing and live BT.656 capture; 25 MHz is the controller limit and never assumed as a production clock.

fpv.rf: replaceable exact serial analog 5.8-GHz receiver module; generic RX5808 is evidence input, not an accepted MPN
fpv.external_connector: MMCX, DC to at least 6 GHz, user-facing and labelled FPV RX 5.8G
fpv.decoder: Texas Instruments TVP5150AM1PBS or industrial-temperature TVP5150AM1IPBS after factory-route confirmation
fpv.capture: Rear K331 CVBS crosses one M1 signal beside ground into UI-local TVP5150; its 8-bit YUV422 plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF enters the independent S3 LCD_CAM camera RX/GDMA path while the LCD TX unit drives i8080 concurrently
fpv.first_acceptance_mode: NTSC/PAL source to centered 320x240 live view at source frame rate with UI overlay/remaining portrait area; uncompressed full-source recording is not promised
fpv.coexistence: Entering FPV mode powers the receiver/decoder group, disables C5 5-GHz RF and all unused transmit groups, and preserves the one-active-signal-group rule.
fpv.power_thermal_gate: Receiver, decoder, regulator and local shielding are added to the unattended thermal and battery budgets before H1 acceptance.
